ns2:course.label: Accounting Measurement, Reporting, and Control
ns2:course.description: A managerial perspective of the nature and role of accounting in organizational measurement, reporting and control processes. Prerequisite: Enrollment in a non-accountancy masters program in business or consent of department.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Enrollment in a non-accountancy masters program in business or consent of department.
